chunks: When two of your bands were about to lose heart God befriended them; and in Him should the faithful place their trust.

key_terms.فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ: let the believers place their trust
key_terms.وَلِيُّهُمَا: His ally or protector for them

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the believers' trust in God during times of weakness or fear?
ai.summary: This verse, revealed during the Battle of Uhud, specifically addresses the internal division among the Muhajirun and Ansar where one faction hesitated to pursue the retreating Quraysh. Shia exegetes often highlight this as a moment of testing the believers' unity and resolve, emphasizing that divine support (Waliyy) is contingent upon steadfastness and reliance on Allah amidst internal discord.
